summary: Chime Financial (CHYM) filed an 8-K disclosing a September 8, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Central Service Corporation, parent of Stride Bank, N.A., for $590 million cash, subject to customary purchase price adjustments, CSC expense deductions, certain pre-closing dividends and preferred redemption. Merger Sub merges into CSC, which survives as a Chime subsidiary. Boards of all parties unanimously approved; CSC common stockholder approval already obtained. Closing conditions include required regulatory approvals, including Board of Governors approval. Watch bank-regulatory timing, purchase-price adjustments and integration risk.
